text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on St. Clair Avenue West, City Council approval of this report is required. Scout Condos Limited Partnership is constructing a 12-storey residential development building with ground floor retail, at 1779-1791 St. Clair Avenue West. The site is located on St. Clair Avenue West and encompasses the entire block between Ford Street and Osler Street. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the east sidewalk and a 2.5-metre-wide portion of the northbound curb lane on Ford Street, between a point 11 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West and a point 47 metres further south, for a period of 19 months (i.e., June 10, 2021 to December 31, 2022) to accommodate a construction staging area. Pedestrian operations on the east side of Ford Street will be maintained in a 1.7-metre-wide covered and protected walkway…

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the closure of the east sidewalk and a 2.5 metre-wide portion of the northbound curb lane on Ford Street, between a point 11 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West and a point 47 metres further south, from June 10, 2021 to December 31, 2022. 2. City Council rescind the existing stopping prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the south side of St. Clair Avenue West, between a point 15 metres east of Ford Street and Osler Street. 3. City Council amend the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday to Friday; 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Saturday at a rate of $2.00 per hour and for a maximum period of 3 hours, on the south side of St. Clair Avenue West, between a point 9 metres east of Ford Street and a point 100 metres east of Laughton Avenue,…
